brand.name: Yuyin
home.title: Text to speech for Hindi, Hinglish, and English.
home.lead: Yuyin streams audio as the text arrives. Numbers, amounts, and mixed-script sentences are spoken the way a person would read them.
placeholder.console.title: Console
placeholder.console.body: The console screens arrive with the component library and mock data.
placeholder.operator.title: Operator
placeholder.operator.body: The operator screens arrive after sign-in and role checks.
auth.signin.title: Sign in
auth.signin.lead: Use the sign-in link your Yuyin operator sent you. Each link works once and expires after 15 minutes.
auth.signin.error: That sign-in link is not valid. Ask your operator for a new one.
auth.signin.noAccount: There is no self-serve sign-up. Organizations and users are created by a Yuyin operator.
org.switcher.label: Organization
textarea.shortcut: Press Ctrl or Cmd plus Enter to submit.
voice.sampleError: The sample could not be played.
voice.hint: Use Up and Down to move, Enter to select, Space to play or pause, Escape to stop.
code.keyNotice: The samples read the key from YUYIN_API_KEY. Set it in your environment and never paste a real key into code.
key.explain: Copy the key now. It cannot be recovered after you finish.
key.label: New API key
key.escapeBlocked: Store the key before closing. Tick the box, then choose Done.
key.gone: The key is hidden and cannot be shown again. Create a new key if you lost it.
key.mintFailed: The key could not be created.
key.mintFailedCause: No key was created. Try again.
meter.label: Prepaid balance
chart.hint: Use the arrow keys to move between points. Press Enter to pin the value.
preview.title: Component previews
preview.lead: Every design-system component with its states. For development and review only.
pulse.label.measured: measured in this browser, including network
preview.pulse.title: Pulse line
preview.pulse.lead: The signature element, driven by a mock audio stream.
screen.home.title: Overview
screen.home.mockNotice: These screens show sample data. Add ?state= to a screen address to open its empty, error, or permission states, for example ?state=empty.
screen.error.title: This screen could not load
screen.error.cause: The data service did not answer. Retry, and quote the trace ID if it happens again.
screen.mock.notConnected: Sample data only. Nothing was saved.
screen.onboarding.title: Get started
screen.onboarding.lead: Three steps from a new organization to your first audio.
screen.onboarding.step1.title: Create an API key
screen.onboarding.step1.body: The key is shown once. Store it in your environment, not in code.
screen.onboarding.step2.title: Send a request
screen.onboarding.step2.body: Send a short Hindi, Hinglish, or English sentence to the speech endpoint.
screen.onboarding.step3.title: Hear the result
screen.onboarding.step3.body: Play the same sentence in the playground and listen to the first audio arrive.
screen.playground.title: Playground
screen.playground.lead: Type a sentence, choose a voice, and listen. The text stays in this page and is not stored.
screen.playground.privacy: Your text is not stored or logged.
screen.playground.zeroBalance: Your balance is zero, so audio cannot be generated.
screen.playground.zeroBalanceReason: Top up your balance to play audio.
screen.playground.overLimitReason: Shorten the text to fit the limit.
screen.keys.title: API keys
screen.keys.lead: Keys let your servers call Yuyin. A key is shown once, when you create it.
screen.keys.hint: Only the prefix and the last four characters are kept on screen.
screen.keys.createBody: Give the key a name that tells you where it is used.
screen.keys.nameRequired: Enter a name for the key.
screen.keys.forbidden: Your role cannot create or revoke keys. Ask an owner or admin.
screen.keys.revokeBody: Requests that use this key stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
screen.keys.empty.title: No API keys yet
screen.keys.empty.body: Create a key to send your first request.
screen.usage.title: Usage
screen.usage.lead: Characters sent for speech, by day, key, and voice. Dates are UTC.
screen.usage.partial: Today's figures are still being added up and may rise.
screen.usage.empty.title: No usage yet
screen.usage.empty.body: Usage appears here after your first request.
screen.billing.title: Billing
screen.billing.lead: Your prepaid balance, top-ups, and invoices. Amounts are in US dollars.
screen.billing.forbidden: Your role can view billing but cannot add funds.
screen.billing.pendingBody: Your balance updates when the payment is confirmed.
screen.billing.failed.title: The payment did not go through
screen.billing.minError: Enter {min} or more, with up to two decimals.
screen.billing.amountReason: Choose an amount at or above the minimum.
screen.billing.ledgerEmpty.title: No balance changes yet
screen.billing.ledgerEmpty.body: Top-ups and usage charges appear here.
screen.lexicon.title: Pronunciation lexicon
screen.lexicon.lead: Tell Yuyin how a word is spoken. Hindi and English entries work the same way.
screen.lexicon.forbidden: Your role cannot change the lexicon.
screen.lexicon.limitReached: The lexicon is full. Remove an entry to add another.
screen.lexicon.addReason: Fill in the written and spoken forms.
screen.lexicon.empty.title: No lexicon entries
screen.lexicon.empty.body: Add a word and how it should be spoken, for example EMI as ई एम आई.
screen.voices.title: Voices
screen.voices.lead: Listen to a voice before you use it. Samples play only when you press Play.
screen.voices.empty.title: No custom voices
screen.voices.empty.body: A custom voice is built from a consented recording and reviewed before use.
screen.voiceRequest.title: Request a custom voice
screen.voiceRequest.lead: Tell us about the voice and confirm you have the speaker's consent.
screen.voiceRequest.notesHelper: Describe the speaker's style and where the voice will be used.
screen.voiceRequest.uploadHelper: Upload a clean recording of the speaker. Uploads are not connected in sample mode.
screen.voiceRequest.consent: The speaker has given written consent for their voice to be used for this purpose.
screen.voiceRequest.submitReason: Confirm the speaker's consent to submit.
screen.voiceRequest.nameReason: Enter a voice name to submit.
screen.voiceRequest.submitted: Request received. Your reference is {id}. We will review it and write to you.
screen.team.title: Team
screen.team.lead: People in this organization and what each role can do.
screen.team.forbidden: Your role can view the team but cannot change it.
screen.team.lastOwner: An organization must keep at least one owner.
screen.team.empty.title: You are the only member
screen.team.empty.body: Invite teammates so they can create keys and view usage.
screen.settings.title: Settings
screen.settings.lead: Organization name, voice defaults, appearance, and alerts.
screen.settings.interfaceHelper: The console text is English only for now.
screen.settings.lowBalanceAlert: Email me when the balance is low
screen.settings.lowBalanceHelper: Sent to organization owners and billing members.
screen.settings.deleteBody: Deleting the organization removes its keys, lexicon, and members. This cannot be undone.
screen.settings.deleteConsequence: All keys stop working and all data is removed.
screen.settings.deleteTypeLabel: Type the organization name to confirm
